title: Business Signal Source
description: A business system Parmana asks for the facts a policy declares in signalSources (RFC-0023), registered through business signal source changes. Nothing is deleted: a revoked registration stays listed.

registrationId.description: The changeId of the approved register change that created it.

name.description: The name a policy's signalSources uses in `source`.

endpointUrl.description: The HTTPS endpoint Parmana posts each signed query to. It is the query's audience.

publicKeyPem.description: The Ed25519 public key, SPKI PEM, the source signs its answers with. When present, an answer without a valid signature is refused as SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

keyId.description: A label for publicKeyPem. When present, an answer signed under another keyId is refused.

status.description: At most one active registration per name.

revokedByChangeId.description: revoked only: the approved change that revoked it.
